item.description: Broken, not dead: Lykias #7411 (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus). The Reapers carry the pieces to Asphodel.

item.title: Polion #3067 nursed the child Krateia Polides ~1165 in the fire for three nights and nobod
item.description: Polion #3067 nursed the child Krateia Polides ~1165 in the fire for three nights and nobody saw. Krateia Polides ~1165 is not bone. But Krateia Polides ~1165 no longer cries, and does not flinch from the hearth.
